Definition: Whether and how the central bank participates in payment system governance beyond its regulatory oversight role, including board representation, operational management, technical standard-setting, or direct system operation.
Comments: BEAC is the regional central bank for CEMAC and is heavily involved in payments: the GIMACPAY IIPS is jointly owned with BEAC holding ~99.2% and BEAC is also the settlement agent (settlement via SYGMA RTGS once daily). However, day-to-day operation is by GIMAC (system operator/technical operator). Evidence: [AfricaNenda SIIPS 2023 CEMAC case study](https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf)
